User: I like spooky movies. What should I watch that has demonic possession themes?
System: Spooky movies are a great choice! Are you looking for something old or something new?
User: Something new. I've seen almost all the classics.
System: What are some of your favorites?
User: Exorcism was ok. I recently watched Annabelle, and it was great.
System: Annabelle is great! There is something about possessed dolls that really just kind of freaks people out isn't there? When I was a kid, I was terrified by the Child's Play movies. Did you like those too?
User: Yeah. I know there are three Annabelle movies, should I watch the next two?
System: Certainly, but I have another in mind that is coming out tomorrow. Have you heard of Brahms: The Boy II?
User: No, I haven't. Is it a sequel?
System: It is and looks crazy scary. Definitely watch the original first as it will set you up to be terrified in this new one. Would you like to view the trailer for the original?
User: Yes that sounds fun.
System: Ok, I will get that queued up for you. In the meantime, here's the Plot: An American nanny is shocked that her new English family's boy is actually a life-sized doll. After she violates a list of strict rules, disturbing events make her believe that the doll is really alive.
User: Sounds great. Thanks for the recommendation.
System: It is my pleasure. This particular one also got 6 nominations. I am sure that sequel is going to....kill....in the box office.
User: I liked the Paranormal Activity movies too. They made a bunch of sequels, and they were all reasonably good and not just a box office cash grab.
System: Those are pretty fantastic. I watched the first two alone in my bedroom with the lights off. They had me looking around the room thinking stuff was moving. The 3rd one I saw in the theater which I think took away from the scariness a bit.
User: While more horror than scary, I liked the original Saw. The sequels and the plotline just got so convoluted and weird.
